# Module: planet (logical, inside `app`)

<!-- Generated by sdlc-context, then reviewed by a human. Keep under ~120 lines. -->

## Purpose

Feed aggregator ("planet"): domain, JPA, feed fetching/updating, scheduled tasks, plus the weblogger-side glue. Merges `org.apache.roller.planet` (standalone planet) and the small `weblogger/planet` glue package.

## Location

- Main (53 files): `app/src/main/java/org/apache/roller/planet` (43: `business` 10 + `fetcher` 3 + `jpa` 3 + `updater` 3, `pojos` 8, `tasks` 5, `util/rome` 9, `config` 1, `util` 1) and `weblogger/planet` (10: `business` 2, `tasks` 2, `ui` 6) [verified: find count]
- Test (14 files): `app/src/test/java/org/apache/roller/planet` (`business` 11, `config` 1) and `.../weblogger/planet` (`business` 1, `ui` 1) [verified: find count]
- Resources: `app/src/main/resources/org/apache/roller/planet/{config,pojos}` [verified: ls]

## Tests

- Scoped run: `-Dtest='org/apache/roller/planet/**,org/apache/roller/weblogger/planet/**'`. Mostly DB-backed manager tests [inferred from names]. Not timed.

## Gotchas

- The `weblogger/planet` glue is deliberately merged here although it lives under `weblogger`; it contains Struts actions (`ui`) that logically belong to ui-struts2 [judgement call]
- Weblogger business wires planet managers through Guice, so planet can not be built or tested without weblogger business [verified: JPAWebloggerModule.java:23-29]
